## Activity

During February 2020, East City Eye Clinic completed 159 captures. Activity was recorded for the month as part of the clinic’s routine eye screening and image capture work. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. No other operational issues were identified in the information provided for this period.

The activity total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes below. The figures relate to the work completed at East City Eye Clinic during February 2020.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 1 set was marked ungradable. This represented an ungradable rate of 0.6 of captures. The result indicates that almost all images obtained during the reporting period were available for assessment. The ungradable result should nevertheless be retained in the routine quality record for the site and month.

## Grading

A total of 33 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 1 day. These results summarise the grading activity associated with the 159 captures completed at East City Eye Clinic in February 2020.
